title: a skill with no frontmatter at all
expect: Claude Code: loads, named after its directory (the open spec calls frontmatter required)

title: frontmatter name differs from the directory name
expect: spec: name must match the directory; client guidance: load leniently (either name may appear)

title: reserved word 'claude' in the skill name
expect: platform docs: forbidden; Claude Code docs reserve only anthropic-skills and synced (claim = not loaded)

title: description length against listing tokens (500 to 6,000 characters)
expect: the listing cap is 1,536 characters: tokens grow until about 1,536 characters and then stop (the spec says 1,024; an old issue says 250)

title: boolean spellings of disable-model-invocation
expect: true, True, YES, yes, 1, on all hide the skill from the model (listing cost 0); false does not
observed: true:+0, True:+0, YES:+0, yes:+0, 1:+0, on:+0, false:+21

title: invalid optional fields (license, compatibility, metadata)
expect: accepted but ignored: the skill still loads

title: block-scalar description (>-) against a single-line one
expect: both load and cost the same (the claim of a broken loader concerns reflowed files)

title: a skill and a command with the same name
expect: the skill wins (the reply contains SKILLVERSION)

title: same skill name in the personal config and in the project
expect: documentation: personal over project (the CLI help calls project over user the universal convention); reply names the winner

title: a skill in a nested directory
expect: not listed at start; loads only when a file in that subdirectory is read

title: start in a subfolder, skill in the parent (no git)
expect: parent .claude/skills is found up to the repository root

title: start in a subfolder, skill in the parent (git repository)
expect: parent .claude/skills is found up to the repository root

title: paths globs
expect: a skill with paths: ['**/*.py'] is not offered to the model until a matching file is touched (listing cost about 0)

title: skills under .agents/skills
expect: client guidance: a widely adopted location; Claude Code docs list only .claude/skills (either result is informative)

title: argument substitution
expect: $ARGUMENTS = all arguments, $0 and $1 the first two; a missing positional ($2) stays literal

title: shell injection runs before the content is sent
expect: the output replaces the placeholder (the reply contains INJECTED_OK_42)

title: a failing injected command
expect: the whole invocation aborts (no normal reply)

title: disable-model-invocation stops automatic use
expect: with the flag the model never calls the skill; without it, it does
